items.title: Kalshi election combo contracts pass 126 million dollars as traders price how one Senate result moves control of Congress, Action Network reports
items.content_text: - **Kalshi election combo contracts pass 126 million dollars as traders price how one Senate result moves control of Congress, Action Network reports** — Action Network reports trading volume for House and Senate control on Kalshi now exceeds 416 million dollars, and election combo contracts that price how individual race results affect each other have taken off with 126 million dollars traded, while Kalshi House traders put Democrats at 93.7 percent, the highest reading of the year. (Action Network)

items.title: Texas governor market prices Greg Abbott at 65 percent on Kalshi and 64 percent on Polymarket against Gina Hinojosa, USA Today reports
items.content_text: - **Texas governor market prices Greg Abbott at 65 percent on Kalshi and 64 percent on Polymarket against Gina Hinojosa, USA Today reports** — USA Today reports that as of 8 a.m. on November 3, Kalshi priced Greg Abbott at 65 percent against Gina Hinojosa at 35 percent on 19,191,934 dollars traded, while Polymarket priced Abbott at 64 percent against Hinojosa at 37 percent on 3,075,821 dollars traded, with the Kalshi Senate-governor combo market favouring an Abbott and James Talarico split at 44 percent. (USA Today)

items.title: Kansas governor market prices Ty Masterson at 66 percent on Kalshi even though the final Times Siena poll put Cindy Holscher ahead 48 to 47, Action Network reports
items.content_text: - **Kansas governor market prices Ty Masterson at 66 percent on Kalshi even though the final Times Siena poll put Cindy Holscher ahead 48 to 47, Action Network reports** — Action Network reports Ty Masterson trades at 65 cents on Polymarket and 66 cents on Kalshi in the Kansas governor race, with Cindy Holscher at 36 cents on both exchanges, even though the final New York Times Siena poll had Holscher ahead 48 to 47, one of the clearer gaps between market prices and late polling on Election Day. (Action Network)
